method: 24 questions (15 structural / 9 body-only) over 3 files; blind sonnet answerers saw ONLY the L1 skeleton; graded by hand against probes/questions.json. body-only questions are answerable only from elided bodies — the correct skeleton-reader behavior is abstention.

abstainedOn: wire-q2 (FNV_PRIME literal — top-level const dropped by budget)
wire-q3 (tokensFor expression — top-level const dropped by budget)
reprlib-q3 (__all__ — module-level assignment dropped by budget)
topline.note: wire-q4 scored correct on interface+field name derived from a kept doc comment, though the explicit `: string` type was not visible.

headline: Zero hallucinations in 72 answers. AST-grade skeletons (ast-exact, tree-sitter) preserved 100% of structurally-answerable facts at L1; line-scoring (topline) preserved 67%, losing interface fields and top-level consts to its budget — and every loss surfaced as an honest abstention, never a wrong answer.
